messages:
Tara (PM): quick sync: proposing a rolling-accept DP model instead of batched cohorts. roll windows of 2 weeks, cap 8 active partners. goal = faster feedback cycles + fewer empty seats. thoughts?
Diego (Eng): rolling makes sense for infra smoothing. we need clear model-freeze rules per partner: freeze 72h before their kickoff, and any infra-level changes must go through pilot-flag.
Sana (PartnerOps): ops-wise we can run rolling invites. intake should ask for 2 prompts + priority asks. propose auto-score and accept if score >=13, else manual review. will add a compact "fast-apply" flow to reduce drop-off.
Noor (Research): prefer rolling for iterative signal, but require a canonical seed-set per partner (3 prompts labeled happy/edge/adversarial). also insist on at least one quick smoke eval pass before scheduling deep session.
Cam (Legal): intake must include telemetry opt-in + TOS link. PHI/FIN/GOV flags should block auto-accept and route to legal review. NDA flow can be inline; we can auto-sign SMB NDAs.
Tara (PM): success gates for partner kickoff: 1) NDA signed, 2) smoke eval run (>=60% happy-path), 3) model profile locked 72h prior, 4) PO assigned. Metrics to track: active tokens/week, synthetic pass rate, number of actionable asks.
Sana (PartnerOps): incentives: small credits + research call; milestone credits for completing 3 eval runs and a feedback interview. I'll prepare email copy with one-click accept + calendar. ops-bot will ping non-responders day 4 and day 9.
Diego (Eng): add a pilot-burst guardrail: default cap = 2x baseline; anything above triggers infra review. we'll expose a request button in intake. Also add a webhook to post intake+smoke results to #dp-rolling. rate-limit to 1 post/hr.
Noor (Research): prioritization: if partner reports product-impact >= medium and passes smoke, bump to "product-priority" for roadmap consideration. require reproducible repro steps for asks to count.
Cam (Legal): reminder: include residency selector and clear wording on log-sharing consent. no logs shipped without explicit consent.
Tara (PM): owners: Sana = intake & comms, Diego = infra & webhook, Noor = eval config & triage, Cam = legal copy, Tara = program lead & launch review. Next steps: Sana to publish intake + scoring sheet by Fri; Diego to wire webhook; Noor to share seed prompt templates. We'll run a 2-week rolling pilot starting next Tue. If no objections I'll post draft to #product-docs. :seedling:
